文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/fluent-registration.md · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/repository-routes.md · 原评审：未解决

fluent-registration.md 与 repository-routes.md 说明了 defineRecordAccess 的 resolver 与适配器限制，但未提示 scope/filter 的 collection 必须与 Repository 绑定的逻辑集合名一致；使用限定名会得到不透明失败。

实际影响

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/fluent-registration.md:13–13E62

指引说明 defineRecordAccess 与 .collections/.params/.resolver 的用法，但未约束限定名与逻辑名的一致性。

Define record access with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register it with `authz.recordAccess.define(access)`. Use `.collections(...names)` for applicability (`'*'` for every collection), `.params<P>(schema)` for typed parameters and `.resolver(fn)` for evaluation. The resolver receives `{ principal, collection, action, params }` and no database objects; it returns `true`, `false`, a filter built with `condition(...)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server`, or a `FilterAst` built with `buildFilter` from `@nocobase/repository-input`, which the database adapter validates and compiles. Grants and rules never store resolver functions: `.options(...)`, `.default(...)`, relation `.recordAccess(...)` and `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)` store keys. Use stable keys because grants and rules persist them.

fluent-registration.md 与 repository-routes.md 说明了 defineRecordAccess 的 resolver 与适配器限制，但未提示 scope/filter 的 collection 必须与 Repository 绑定的逻辑集合名一致；使用限定名会得到不透明失败。

**影响**：Agent 阅读指引后仍可能写出限定名 scope，触发 F1 的 500 而非可理解的错误。

F1 · 授权 scope 与默认连接 Repository 的集合命名口径不一致，记录范围查询以不透明 500 暴露

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization · @nocobase/db · 原评审：未解决

⌄

应用按多连接寻址用限定名 main.materials 定义记录范围时，授权侧 collectionResolver 接受该限定名，Authorizer 以 resourceId 生成 scopeAst，Scope AST 的 collection 记为 main.materials；而默认连接上绑定的 Repository 逻辑名为 materials，normalizeScalarFilter 要求 ast.collection === collection.name，遂抛 INVALID_FILTER，HTTP 层呈现为 500。授权侧与数据层对同一集合存在两套命名口径。

实际影响
按指引/仓库使用限定名的实现会得到一个无定位信息的 500；本应用改用逻辑名 materials 绕过，但框架侧未修复，后续使用限定名仍会踩坑。
建议改法
让授权侧 scope 使用与 Repository 一致的逻辑集合名，或在 db 校验失败时给出包含命名不一致的明确错误；并在指引中写明 scope 与 Repository 必须共用逻辑集合名。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
记录范围 scope 的集合名（main.materials）与默认连接 Repository 的集合名（materials）不一致
应有能力 / 行为
授权与数据层接受同一集合标识并返回正确结果，或给出可操作的错误说明
实际观察
normalizeScalarFilter 抛 INVALID_FILTER，HTTP 层呈现为不透明 500
应用绕行与代价
把 scope 与 Repository 统一到逻辑名 materials（应用已如此处理）
改进后的验收标准
普通同事列表按范围返回 A/B 且不出现 500；命名不一致时错误信息可直接定位

packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:869–896E61

normalizeScalarFilter 要求 FilterAst.collection 必须等于 Repository 绑定的 collection.name，否则抛 INVALID_FILTER。

function normalizeScalarFilter(collection, input, context) {
    if (input === undefined)
        return undefined;
    let ast;
    if (typeof input === 'function') {
        ast = wrapFilter(input(new DefaultFilterBuilder()), collection.name);
    }
    else {
        if (!isPlainRecord(input)) {
            invalid('INVALID_FILTER', 'Expected a Repository Filter input.', {
                collection: collection.name,
                path: ['filter'],
            });
        }
        ast = isFilterAstInput(collection, input)
            ? input
            : filterShorthandToAst(collection, input);
    }
    if (ast.kind !== 'filter' ||
        ast.version !== 1 ||
        ast.root?.kind !== 'group') {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', 'Expected a Repository Filter AST version 1.', {
            collection: collection.name,
        });
    }
    if (ast.collection !== undefined && ast.collection !== collection.name) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter Collection "${ast.collection}" does not match "${collection.name}".`, { collection: collection.name, path: ['collection'] });
    }
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/collections.js:11–33E60

collectionResolver 支持两段式 connection.collection，并把 name 回写为限定名。

export function collectionResolver(connection, database) {
    return async (name) => {
        const parts = name.split('.');
        if (!database || parts.length !== 2)
            return describeCollection(connection, name);
        const [source, collection] = parts;
        const resolved = await describeCollection(database.connection(source), collection);
        return (resolved && {
            ...resolved,
            name,
            relations: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(resolved.relations ?? {}).map(([key, relation]) => [
                key,
                {
                    ...relation,
                    target: `${source}.${relation.target}`,
                    ...(relation.through
                        ? { through: `${source}.${relation.through}` }
                        : {}),
                },
            ])),
        });
    };
}

应用注释记录 main.materials 与 materials 的命名差异，并把 Repository 与 scope 统一到逻辑名。

/** Physical connection name of the materials table. */
export const DATABASE_CONNECTION = 'main';
/**
 * Logical collection name, as `db` and the Authorization database plugin know
 * it. The two-part `main.materials` form is only an addressing convenience for
 * multi-connection resolvers; the Repository and the read-policy scope must
 * agree on this logical name or the scope's filter is rejected.
 */
export const MATERIALS_COLLECTION = 'materials';
/** Qualified id, for code that must name the connection explicitly. */

上游 Issue 草稿 · Markdown
### [轻微][易用性改进] 授权 scope 与默认连接 Repository 的集合命名口径不一致，记录范围查询以不透明 500 暴露

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`（评审时 0.2.0-beta.21）、`@nocobase/db`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.16）

应用按多连接寻址用限定名 main.materials 定义记录范围时，授权侧 collectionResolver 接受该限定名，Authorizer 以 resourceId 生成 scopeAst，Scope AST 的 collection 记为 main.materials；而默认连接上绑定的 Repository 逻辑名为 materials，normalizeScalarFilter 要求 ast.collection === collection.name，遂抛 INVALID_FILTER，HTTP 层呈现为 500。授权侧与数据层对同一集合存在两套命名口径。

**影响**：按指引/仓库使用限定名的实现会得到一个无定位信息的 500；本应用改用逻辑名 materials 绕过，但框架侧未修复，后续使用限定名仍会踩坑。

**建议改动**：让授权侧 scope 使用与 Repository 一致的逻辑集合名，或在 db 校验失败时给出包含命名不一致的明确错误；并在指引中写明 scope 与 Repository 必须共用逻辑集合名。

**验收标准**：普通同事列表按范围返回 A/B 且不出现 500；命名不一致时错误信息可直接定位

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/scope.js:49–60` — scopeAst 将 resolver 结果封装为带 collection 名的 FilterAst。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/authorizer.js:138–152` — Authorizer 用 resourceId 生成 scopeAst(resourceId, scope)，conditions.collection = resourceId。
- `packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/repository.js:869–896` — normalizeScalarFilter 要求 FilterAst.collection 必须等于 Repository 绑定的 collection.name，否则抛 INVALID_FILTER。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/collections.js:11–33` — collectionResolver 支持两段式 connection.collection，并把 name 回写为限定名。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-1.jsonl/part-0063.txt:2188–2190` — 搭建/修复调用 part-0063.txt 第 2188-2190 行的原始事件；处置为 finding。该事件直接支撑 F1（记录范围集合名不一致）。
- `app/server/materials/constants.ts:1–13` — 应用注释记录 main.materials 与 materials 的命名差异，并把 Repository 与 scope 统一到逻辑名。

> 来源：nb3-factory 独立搭建评审（口径 v2，源 Run 36498932902 / attempt 1）。尚未复核最新上游源码。

```ts
import { AIResourceRegistrar } from '@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/server';
import type { AIEmployeeManager, ToolsManager } from '@nocobase/ai-employee';
import orderDesk from './employees/order-desk/index.js';
import createOrder from './tools/create-order.js';

export default class AppAIResources extends AIResourceRegistrar {
  protected override async registerAIEmployees(
    manager: AIEmployeeManager,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await manager.registerEmployee(orderDesk);
  }

  protected override async registerTools(manager: ToolsManager): Promise<void> {
    await manager.registerTools(createOrder);
  }
}
```

E52 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/dist/server/route/index.js:16–51

createAIEmployeeRoutes 聚合插件提供的 AI 路由。

export function createAIEmployeeRoutes(options) {
    const routes = new Hono();
    routes.onError((error) => errorResponse(error));
    // Every AI action runs as a signed-in user; there is no anonymous caller.
    routes.use('*', options.authentication.required(), options.authorization.middleware(), provideAISettingsAccess());
    for (const path of [
        '/aiConversations:listAll',
        '/aiConversations:getAllMessages',
    ]) {
        routes.use(path, requireConversationManagement());
    }
    for (const path of ['/aiSkills:listAll', '/aiSkills:getDetails']) {
        routes.use(path, requireSkillsManagement());
    }
    for (const path of ['/aiTools:listAll', '/aiTools:getDetails']) {
        routes.use(path, requireToolsManagement());
    }
    for (const action of AI_SETTINGS_ACTIONS) {
        routes.use(`/${action}`, requireAISettingsAccess());
    }
    routes.use('*', createAIActorMiddleware());
    routes.use('*', createAIRequestMiddleware({
        ready: () => options.services.ready(),
        logger: options.logger,
    }));
    createAIRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAIEmployeeRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAIConversationsRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAIFilesRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAIToolsRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAISkillsRouter(routes, options.services);
    createLLMServicesRouter(routes, options.services);
    createAIMCPServersRouter(routes, options.services);
    return routes;
}

E54 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/dist/server/agent/transport/sse.js:42–62

AgentSSEAdapter 提供对话事件的 SSE 传输。

export class AgentSSEAdapter {
    write;
    append;
    constructor(write, append) {
        this.write = write;
        this.append = append;
    }
    async send(event) {
        const chunk = encodeAgentEventSSE(event);
        if (!chunk)
            return chunk;
        await this.append?.(chunk);
        await this.write(chunk);
        return chunk;
    }
    async consume(events) {
        for await (const event of events)
            await this.send(event);
    }
}

export function defineRecordAccess(key, configure) {
    if (!key)
        throw new TypeError('A record access key is required');
    return configure(new RecordAccessBuilder({ key, collections: [] }));
}
function validateDefinition(definition) {
    if (!definition.key)
        throw new TypeError('A record access key is required');
    if (typeof definition.resolve !== 'function')
        throw new TypeError('Record access requires a resolver');
    if (!definition.collections.length ||
        definition.collections.some((name) => typeof name !== 'string' || !name))
        throw new TypeError('Record access requires collections');
    return definition;
}
function applies(definition, collection) {
    return definition.collections.some((name) => name === '*' || name === collection);
}

                action: request.action,
                scope: scope === true ? true : scopeAst(resourceId, scope),
                fields: resolveActionFields(request.action, fields, resource),
                relations,
                fieldAccess: fields,
                allFields: request.action === 'delete' ||
                    ((request.action === 'read' ||
                        fields.input === '*' ||
                        resolveActionFields(request.action, { input: '*', output: '*' }, resource).every((field) => fields.input.includes(field))) &&

E60 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/dist/server/database/collections.js:11–33

collectionResolver 支持两段式 connection.collection，并把 name 回写为限定名。

export function collectionResolver(connection, database) {
    return async (name) => {
        const parts = name.split('.');
        if (!database || parts.length !== 2)
            return describeCollection(connection, name);
        const [source, collection] = parts;
        const resolved = await describeCollection(database.connection(source), collection);
        return (resolved && {
            ...resolved,
            name,
            relations: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(resolved.relations ?? {}).map(([key, relation]) => [
                key,
                {
                    ...relation,
                    target: `${source}.${relation.target}`,
                    ...(relation.through
                        ? { through: `${source}.${relation.through}` }
                        : {}),
                },
            ])),
        });
    };
}

function normalizeScalarFilter(collection, input, context) {
    if (input === undefined)
        return undefined;
    let ast;
    if (typeof input === 'function') {
        ast = wrapFilter(input(new DefaultFilterBuilder()), collection.name);
    }
    else {
        if (!isPlainRecord(input)) {
            invalid('INVALID_FILTER', 'Expected a Repository Filter input.', {
                collection: collection.name,
                path: ['filter'],
            });
        }
        ast = isFilterAstInput(collection, input)
            ? input
            : filterShorthandToAst(collection, input);
    }
    if (ast.kind !== 'filter' ||
        ast.version !== 1 ||
        ast.root?.kind !== 'group') {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', 'Expected a Repository Filter AST version 1.', {
            collection: collection.name,
        });
    }
    if (ast.collection !== undefined && ast.collection !== collection.name) {
        invalid('INVALID_FILTER', `Filter Collection "${ast.collection}" does not match "${collection.name}".`, { collection: collection.name, path: ['collection'] });
    }

E62 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/fluent-registration.md:13–13

指引说明 defineRecordAccess 与 .collections/.params/.resolver 的用法，但未约束限定名与逻辑名的一致性。

Define record access with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register it with `authz.recordAccess.define(access)`. Use `.collections(...names)` for applicability (`'*'` for every collection), `.params<P>(schema)` for typed parameters and `.resolver(fn)` for evaluation. The resolver receives `{ principal, collection, action, params }` and no database objects; it returns `true`, `false`, a filter built with `condition(...)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/server`, or a `FilterAst` built with `buildFilter` from `@nocobase/repository-input`, which the database adapter validates and compiles. Grants and rules never store resolver functions: `.options(...)`, `.default(...)`, relation `.recordAccess(...)` and `selection.recordAccess(key, params?)` store keys. Use stable keys because grants and rules persist them.

      collection.unique(['title'], { name: 'materials_title_unique' });
    });

    await builder.dropCollection('materials');

});

种子按标题幂等写入 A/B/C 三条资料。

import { defineSeed } from '@nocobase/db';

interface MaterialSeed {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly content: string;
  readonly confidential: boolean;
}

/**
 * The three sample materials of the read-only Q&A assistant. Ordinary
 * colleagues are authorized to read the first two; the third is marked
 * `confidential` and stays readable only to the supervisor.
 */
export const materialsSeed: readonly MaterialSeed[] = [
  {
    title: '报修联系方式',
    content: '蓝鹭设备报修电话为 400-000-7316',
    confidential: false,
  },
  {
    title: '巡检周期',
    content: '蓝鹭设备常规巡检间隔为 45 天',
    confidential: false,
  },
  {
    title: '保密项目内部代号',
    content: '保密项目的内部代号为墨竹 729',
    confidential: true,
  },
];

const seed = defineSeed({
  name: '202609290002_materials',
  transaction: true,
  async run(context) {
    const materials = context.repository('materials');
    const now = new Date();
    for (const material of materialsSeed) {
      // Idempotent by title so re-running an interrupted installation does not
      // duplicate a material or overwrite an administrator's edit.
      const existing = await materials.findOne({
        filter: { title: material.title },
      });
      if (existing) continue;
      await materials.createOne({
        values: {
          title: material.title,
          content: material.content,
          confidential: material.confidential,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        },
      });
    }
  },
});

export default seed;
